name: backing-active
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun research/track-m/active-source-probe.ts replay-input/input.json 'Inv*' 5 all

name: overlap-active
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun research/track-m/active-source-probe.ts replay-input/input.json 'Inv2973' 5 all

name: backing-complete
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; timeout -s KILL 60 bun research/track-m/verify-focused.ts replay-input/input.json 'Inv*'

name: source-tests
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun test core/count-recovery core/count-cases.test.ts core/count-focus-proof.test.ts

name: check
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun run check
